decision.observation: At 8:50 am the farmer remains pinned near the farm's east boundary (~0.87,0.42) beside the vertical road/fence strip; several moves were blocked (clock frozen). A pink blossom tree stands above-right.
decision.hypothesis: Following the east road north along the boundary leads to the north road and the bus stop toward town, where I can greet villagers indoors during rain.
decision.memory: Day 2 route to town: north from the farm to the road, east past the bus stop, then the plaza. Introductions: 6/28.
